name: hx_fem_evaporator_discretised
title: Discretised (finite-volume) evaporator with three U-value zones
summary: Counterflow evaporator discretised in N cells by a PROCEDURE with a REPEAT-UNTIL loop; the overall heat-transfer coefficient passes smoothly from liquid to two-phase to vapour values over a 0.1 quality window (the smoothing that fixes the convergence problems of the earlier sharp-switching revision TM-0275). Water inlet temperature imposed, water outlet and refrigerant outlet solved by iteration over the procedure.
language_features: lookup table write in procedure (not executed, warning P009)

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution: 21 common variables, 3 differ at rtol=0.001, max 2.20e-03 on the R245fa enthalpies and Q_dot (property backend).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (23 variables)
verification.notes: 21 common variables, max rel. diff 2.20e-03 (rtol=0.001) on the R245fa absolute enthalpies h_su/h_ex and Q_dot (EES vs CoolProp backend, within the 0.5 % tolerance); all temperatures and T_hf_ex agree; outlet two-phase in both tools (DELTAT_ex = 0). Comparison made with the solution of the earlier runnable variant, which the native file reproduces in all 32 variables (CoolSolve 0.3.0@4798e2b); the seven lookup-cell writes of the procedure are reported (P009) and not executed.
